test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The cost price of an article is ₹800. After allowing a discount of 10%, a gain of 12.5% was made. The marked price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

C.P of article = Rs.800

Discount given = 10%

Profit = 12.5%

**Formula used:**

C.P/M.P = (100 - discount %)/(100 ± profit/loss %)

**Calculation:**

By applying the formula 

C.P/M.P = (100 - discount %)/(100 + profit%)

⇒ 800/M.P = (100 - 10)/(100 + 12.5)

⇒ M.P = (800 × 112.5)/90

⇒ M.P = 1000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1000.**
